#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int count(const vector<int>& arr, int l, int r) {
    bool seen[24] = {false};
    int cnt = 0;
    for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i) {
        int c = arr[i];
        if (!seen[c]) {
            seen[c] = true;
            ++cnt;
        }
    }
    return cnt;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, left, right;
    cin >> a >> b >> left >> right;
    left -= 1;
    right -= 1;
    int period = a + b;
    vector<int> arr(period * 4, 0);

    int shift = left / period;
    left -= shift * period;
    right -= shift * period;
    shift = (right - left + 1) / period;
    if (shift > 2) {
        right -= (shift - 2) * period;
    }

    int d = (a > b) ? (a - b) : 1;

    for (int block = 0; block < 4; ++block) {
        int base = period * block;
        for (int pos = 0; pos < a; ++pos) {
            if ((block & 1) == 1 && pos >= a - d) {
                arr[base + pos] = pos + d;
            } else {
                arr[base + pos] = pos;
            }
        }
    }

    int min_val = a + a;
    for (int k0 = 1; k0 <= d; ++k0) {
        for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k) {
            arr[a + k] = arr[a - k0];
        }
        for (int k1 = 1; k1 <= d; ++k1) {
            for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k) {
                arr[period + a + k] = arr[period + a - k1];
            }
            for (int k2 = 1; k2 <= d; ++k2) {
                for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k) {
                    arr[2 * period + a + k] = arr[2 * period + a - k2];
                }
                for (int k3 = 1; k3 <= d; ++k3) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < b; ++k) {
                        arr[3 * period + a + k] = arr[3 * period + a - k3];
                    }
                    min_val = min(min_val, count(arr, left, right));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << min_val << endl;
    return 0;
}
